semiconductor_relevance: High — Sekisui Chemical provides a wide range of functional resin products specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Sekisui Chemical Co., Ltd offers a diverse portfolio of materials for the semiconductor industry, including tapes, films, heat dissipation materials, and encapsulants. Their products are tailored for back-end processes and substrate manufacturing, addressing advanced needs such as miniaturization and high-density designs.
capabilities: Functional resin products for semiconductor packaging

regional_presence.Japan: Sekisui Chemical is a Japanese company with a strong presence in the semiconductor materials market.
